beats.intent: ThinkSR runs dense image features through windows, applies shared DQ-CTM ticks, and decodes the updated field.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.
beats.narration: The method keeps a dense carrier so super-resolution still has a spatial field to work with. The encoder produces the dense features that carry image detail forward. Windowing makes the dense field usable by the compact thought process. The DQ-CTM thought stage runs recurrent ticks with shared parameters, returning to itself each time. The decoder turns the updated dense carrier back into the super-resolved image.

params.headline: ThinkSR keeps dense features while compact thought iterates
params.note: The loop returns to the thought stage, not the whole flow.

beats.intent: The carrier equation first creates a dense feature field, then partitions it into windows without dropping tokens.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.
beats.narration: The equation names the dense carrier that bridges compact thought and dense output. The encoder maps the low-resolution image into a dense feature field. The low-resolution image is the input whose spatial information must be preserved. The window partition operates on that dense field and keeps every token for the thought process.

params.headline: The dense carrier is encoded first, then windowed

terms.label: encoder that creates the dense feature field
window partition that keeps every token

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is not the smallest model in the benchmark; at 1.129 million parameters, it is second largest of five.
beats.claim: Table 1 — ×4 lightweight super-resolution, average over five benchmarks.
beats.narration: The benchmark includes five lightweight super-resolution methods with parameter counts in millions. CATANet is the smallest reported model at zero point five three five million parameters. RFDN and IMDN are also smaller than DQ-CTM-SR. DQ-CTM-SR has one point one two nine million parameters, making it the second largest of the five. CARN is the largest reported model at one point five nine two million parameters.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is second largest by parameter count
params.note: Smallest first; DQ-CTM-SR is second largest.
